sloka: वृत्तकामो भवेद्भ्राता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत् ।वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः ।। ६.११३.२१ ।।
transliteration: vṛttakāmo bhavedbhrātā rāmo mitrakulaṁ bhavet ।vayaṁ cāvidhavāḥ sarvāḥ sakāmā na ca śatravaḥ ।। 6.113.21 ।।

translations.english: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."
